definitions.explanation: A person who professionally analyzes and critiques works of art, literature, politics, or other fields. Can also be used dismissively to describe someone who only criticizes without taking action themselves.

examples.japanese: {有名|ゆうめい}な{映画|えいが}{評論家|ひょうろんか}がこの{作品|さくひん}を{絶賛|ぜっさん}した。
examples.english: A famous film critic praised this work highly.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{口|くち}ばかりの{評論家|ひょうろんか}だ。
examples.english: He's just an armchair critic who only talks.

examples.japanese: {政治|せいじ}{評論家|ひょうろんか}たちがテレビで{選挙|せんきょ}の{結果|けっか}について{議論|ぎろん}していた。
examples.english: Political commentators were discussing the election results on television.

notes:
USAGE:
When used in its professional sense, {評論家|ひょうろんか} is neutral. However, when applied to an ordinary person, it often carries a negative connotation suggesting they criticize without contributing or acting themselves.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {映画|えいが}{評論家|ひょうろんか} (film critic)
- {文芸|ぶんげい}{評論家|ひょうろんか} (literary critic)
- {政治|せいじ}{評論家|ひょうろんか} (political commentator)
- {音楽|おんがく}{評論家|ひょうろんか} (music critic)

WORD FORMATION:
{評論|ひょうろん} (criticism, critique) + {家|か} (professional suffix). The suffix {家|か} indicates a person who practices a skill or profession.
